svg.metadata: Kota Bandung kecamatan boundaries converted from tryfatur/geojson-bandung, 3273-kota-bandung-level-kecamatan.json. The source repository documents the data as based on Permendagri No. 66/2011 and Bandung Perda No. 10/2015. Source: https://github.com/tryfatur/geojson-bandung Conversion preserves every source coordinate and applies only an equirectangular screen projection with two-decimal SVG coordinate rounding.
